scripts.build: pnpm rules:validate && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.typecheck: pnpm rules:prepare && pnpm exec wrangler types && tsc --noEmit
scripts.deploy: pnpm rules:validate && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --keep-vars
scripts.rules:validate: pnpm rules:prepare && node scripts/generate-rule-validator.mjs --check && tsx scripts/rules-cli.ts validate
